AMD FidelityFX SDK v2.4.0 API headers (MIT, see the notice at the top of each file), from
https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/FidelityFX-SDK/tree/v2.4.0/Kits/FidelityFX
(same layout: api/include, upscalers/include, framegeneration/include). Only the C headers the mod
includes are here. AMD's signed runtime DLLs are not included: players download them from AMD.
